Microsoft Reports Fiscal Third Quarter of 2026 Results

REDMOND, Wash. — July 30, 2026 — Microsoft Corporation today announced financial results for the fiscal third quarter of 2026.

Revenue increased 14 percent to $70.1 billion.

  • Intelligent Cloud revenue was $34.2 billion, up 18 percent.
  • Personal Computing revenue was $35.9 billion.
